title: Concept Unlearning via Cross-Attention Activation Projection for Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.25765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing closed-form methods for concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models typically derive editing directions from fixed text embeddings, which may not fully capture how concepts are expressed across latent states, timesteps, and layers. To capture this variation, we investigate cross-attention activations collected during denoising. In controlled probing experiments using the same anchor prompts, activation-derived bases achieve approximately five times the recall of text-derived bases on held-out prompts expressing the target concepts. Based on this finding, we propose Cross-Attention Subspace Erasure (CASE), a closed-form method that constructs layer-specific forget and retain subspaces from cross-attention activations. These subspaces define a retain-constrained linear operator incorporated directly into cross-attention weights, requiring no gradient-based fine-tuning or additional inference-time computation. Ac

translated_title: 基于交叉注意力激活投影的扩散模型概念遗忘方法
translated_abstract: 现有的文本到图像扩散模型概念遗忘的闭式方法通常从固定的文本嵌入中推导编辑方向，这可能无法充分捕捉概念在不同潜在状态、时间步和网络层之间的表达方式。为了捕捉这种变化，我们研究了去噪过程中收集的交叉注意力激活。在使用相同锚点提示的受控探测实验中，基于激活推导的基底在表达目标概念的保留提示上的召回率约为基于文本推导基底的五倍。基于这一发现，我们提出了交叉注意力子空间擦除（CASE），这是一种闭式方法，可从交叉注意力激活中构建特定于层的遗忘子空间和保留子空间。这些子空间定义了一个受保留约束的线性算子，可直接嵌入交叉注意力权重中，无需基于梯度的微调，也不会增加推理时的计算开销。
tldr: 提出CASE方法，利用交叉注意力激活构建层特定的遗忘与保留子空间，并将保留约束的线性算子直接嵌入注意力权重，以闭式方式实现扩散模型概念遗忘，无需梯度微调且不增加推理开销。
en_tdlr: Proposes CASE, a closed-form concept unlearning method that constructs layer-specific forget and retain subspaces from cross-attention activations and embeds a retain-constrained linear operator directly into attention weights, requiring no gradient-based fine-tuning or extra inference-time computation.
